scope: Architecture.md only: Redis exact generic-query embedding cache, no implementation or spec changes.
semantic_observations: Generic vocabulary eligibility checked before hashing; no learner/freeform/private inputs.
Single initial cache: query vectors; current authorized retrieval and domain approval remain in PostgreSQL.
Expiry and model/config versioning, bounded memory, fallback and privacy tests defined as future behavior.
Teaching routes unchanged; local links exist, paired fences and authored whitespace valid; existing JSON parses.
limits: No Redis/client/model/runtime/cache tests executed. Cache usefulness and TTL are design choices, not measured outcomes.
